name: marutto.art
summary: Free illustration library of 1,000+ downloadable images plus a mix tool for combining them into your own works.
description: A site with free illustration materials that download per item as transparent PNG or SVG, and a Mix tool where you pick items, recolour them and combine them into a work. Works are shared in a gallery that others can remix, with a calendar of daily works; the site runs in seven languages.
contains: categories: animals, plants, food, seasonal, daily life, sea animals, insects, decorations
per-item transparent PNG and SVG download
free for commercial use, modification allowed, no credit required
Mix tool to pick and combine items into a work
seven languages; sub-sites tinyworld.marutto.art and pixel.marutto.art
